dedupe_keys.name: internet of blockchain energy network cyberattack classification results

description: This collection provides result tables and figures for cyberattack identification in an Internet-of-Blockchain energy network. University of Vaasa collaborators model wind and solar communications using RTDS and OPAL-RT, with software-based network and classifier components. The article describes a 250-node arrangement, IEC 61850 devices and fifteen-minute acquisition, while the repository does not give exact calendar dates. Mendeley version 1 lists thirty CSV and image files free under CC BY 4.0. The published tables summarize denial-of-service detection and classification experiments; they are not a complete operating power-system trace. Coverage is a modelled laboratory network. Simulation assumptions, selected attack classes and aggregation limit transfer to field reliability or incident-frequency estimates. A reviewer-assessed use is comparing classifier and communications-performance assumptions within coupled electricity and network simulations. platform-ns-3 is a related network environment, without verified compatibility. No real-time simulator, classifier, data table or attack mechanism was downloaded or executed.
